description: Knowledgemonger-LLC org-wide base Renovate preset. Consumed by every repo via a thin renovate.json that does: extends: ["github>Knowledgemonger-LLC/renovate-config"]. A bare github> reference with no path resolves to THIS file (default.json at the repo root), so it must stay named default.json and live at the root.
This file is the org default. Per-repo overrides (extra packageRules, a different schedule, additional presets) belong in each consumer's own renovate.json ALONGSIDE the extends — not here.

timezone is set here rather than per-repo because schedule strings are meaningless without it: Renovate defaults to UTC, so 'before 9am on monday' would fire at 4am or 5am Eastern depending on daylight saving. A schedule and the timezone it is written against have to travel together.

packageRules.description: Automerge devDependencies for minor/patch updates — low risk, keeps toolchain current without manual review. minimumReleaseAge is load-bearing rather than cosmetic: automerge means no human reads these before they land, and Renovate only waits on status checks that actually exist — most repos in this org have no CI at all, so a bad release would merge unopposed. Waiting 7 days means a compromised or broken release is usually yanked or publicly disclosed before it can reach a default branch.
